app_documentation: UniStudy is a comprehensive university student study platform designed to facilitate collaborative learning and knowledge sharing among students. The application serves as a centralized hub where students can upload, browse, and download study notes shared by their peers, create and join subject-specific study groups for collaborative learning, and stay informed about new educational resources through an intelligent notification system. The platform features a modern, mobile-responsive interface built with React and Node.js, supporting secure user authentication, file management through AWS S3, and a robust rating system to ensure content quality. Intended users include university students seeking to enhance their learning experience through peer collaboration, share their knowledge with classmates, and access high-quality study materials across various subjects. The platform also supports admin and moderator roles for content governance and community management.

glossary.Study Notes: Digital educational materials (PDFs, documents) uploaded by students and stored in AWS S3, categorized by subject and available for download by other students on the platform
glossary.Study Group: A collaborative learning space where students can join together based on specific subjects to participate in discussions, share resources, and engage in group activities
glossary.Rating System: A quality assurance mechanism allowing students to rate study notes on a scale of 1-5 stars and provide written reviews to help others identify high-quality content
glossary.Subject Subscription: A feature enabling students to follow specific academic subjects and receive notifications when new study notes are uploaded in those subjects
glossary.JWT Authentication: JSON Web Token-based security system used to securely authenticate users and manage session tokens for accessing protected platform features
glossary.Notification System: An automated alert mechanism that informs students about new notes in subscribed subjects, group activities, and other relevant platform updates
